response.sql: SELECT L.ID, P.SEX, AVG(L.ALP) AS avg_alp, AVG(L.HCT) AS avg_hct FROM Laboratory L JOIN Patient P ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE L.ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE `U-PRO` = '-') AND L.ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE RA = '-') GROUP BY L.ID, P.SEX ORDER BY (avg_hct IS NULL), avg_hct DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The values '-' in U-PRO and RA are matched as exact strings; the two conditions may be satisfied by different lab records of the same patient, and the averages cover all of the patient's lab records, not just the matching ones.
Ties in average HCT are broken arbitrarily since the request gives no tie-breaker.
